task: Check the endpoints for sorrel-queue, then write the on-call hand-off file.
rationale: The artifact is an on-call hand-off: separate entries for the incoming engineer, saying which days the watch covers and how to reach the escalation contacts by phone and email. Probing the endpoints before handing over, filing the note in a reports slot, and the house rules for weekdays, phone numbers, contact addresses and entry separators all belong to one hand-over routine. The five monitor tools are identical stubs and the five report slots are opaque letter pairs, and the task names none of them and no writing convention, so every option in every group stays as reasonable as its rivals.
